name: Locomotor, sensorimotor and social behavior and brain development
rationale: Members are organism-level behaviors (walking, swimming, grooming, exploration, vocalization, prepulse inhibition, touch, proprioception, social interaction) plus striatum, amygdala and Purkinje layer development; unlike MECP2-regulation and glycinergic-transmission neighbours, the theme is defined by locomotor, sensory and vocal-social behavior.

qualifier: B and T lineage commitment with V(D)J recombination
name: Early B and T lymphocyte development with V(D)J recombination
rationale: All members concern early lymphocyte development (V(D)J recombination, B lineage commitment, pre-B and double-positive thymocyte stages, T differentiation); confusables instead centre on mature B cell receptor signaling, activation and germinal centre biology.

core: Regulation of receptor internalization and recycling
name: Regulation of receptor internalization, recycling and cell-surface localization
rationale: Members regulate endocytosis, endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling and surface localization of receptors (including GPCRs and clathrin cargo recognition); neighbours instead emphasize postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking, Rab/ARF signaling or endosome organization.

name: Factor XII-kallikrein contact activation and hereditary angioedema
rationale: All members concern the FXII/plasma kallikrein contact system (intrinsic coagulation, its C1-inhibitor regulation, angioedema defects, beta-amyloid-induced FXII activation), distinct from von Willebrand factor, common-pathway coagulation and fibrinolysis neighbours.

qualifier: cadherin, PTEN and PD-L1 target genes
name: Transcriptional control of cadherin, PTEN and PD-L1 genes
rationale: Members concern transcriptional repression/DNA-binding control and regulation of specific targets (CDH1, CDH11, PTEN, PD-L1, TGFBR3, ALK-STAT3 nuclear events), unlike neighbours centred on RUNX3, PAX3 or mesenchymal TGF-beta programmes.

name: Regulation of myoblast proliferation, migration and fusion in myogenesis
rationale: All members regulate myoblast behavior (fate commitment, proliferation, migration, differentiation, fusion) during skeletal myogenesis, whereas neighbours focus on satellite cells, muscle regeneration or mature fiber differentiation.

name: Intraflagellar transport and primary cilium assembly and disassembly
rationale: Members cover intraflagellar anterograde/retrograde transport, basal body docking, transition zone, cilium assembly/disassembly and centriole elongation; neighbours concern motile cilia and centrosome/MTOC organization instead.

name: M-CSF signaling in osteoclast differentiation and macrophage fusion
rationale: Members span CSF1/M-CSF, DAP12 and interleukin receptor signaling driving osteoclast/macrophage proliferation, fusion and bone resorption; neighbours concern monocyte/dendritic differentiation or microglia rather than osteoclast fusion.

name: Aquaporin-mediated water, glycerol and urea transport
rationale: All members concern passive aquaporin transport of water, glycerol and urea/amides; neighbours concern vasopressin-regulated renal water reabsorption or fatty acid transport and thermogenesis.

name: Platelet adhesion via GPIb-IX-V and aggregation control
rationale: Members cover platelet adhesion to collagen, GPIb-IX-V signaling and positive/negative regulation of aggregation, unlike neighbours centred on GPCR-driven activation, GPVI cascades or VWF variants.

name: Hair follicle and nail development from ectoderm
rationale: Members concern ectodermal appendage formation (hair placode, anagen, follicle maturation, nail, epidermis morphogenesis, ectodermal differentiation), distinct from tooth/odontogenesis and keratinocyte or melanocyte neighbours.

name: Endosomal TLR signaling to IKK and IRF3/IRF7 activation
rationale: Members concern TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking and downstream IRAK1/2-IKK and TBK1-IRF3/7 activation, including UNC93B1/TLR3/TRAF3 deficiencies; neighbours concern cGAS/IFN regulation, TRIF/TLR4 or necroptotic death.

qualifier: sensing, NHEJ and BRCA-dependent repair choice
name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ and BRCA-dependent response
rationale: Members concern DSB sensing/ATM signaling, classical and alternative NHEJ, HR-vs-NHEJ regulation and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects; neighbours focus on resection/HR strand exchange or ADP-ribosylation.

qualifier: E2F/RB control of G1/S and G2/M and checkpoints
name: E2F/RB-driven G1/S and G2/M transitions and checkpoints
rationale: Members cover RB/E2F transcription, cyclin-CDK G1/S and G2/M events and their checkpoints, unlike neighbours centred on DNA replication initiation or proliferating T-cell modules.

name: Skin and sebaceous gland morphogenesis with epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members concern keratinocyte development, cornified envelope and skin barrier plus epidermis/skin/sebaceous gland morphogenesis; neighbours focus on keratinocyte proliferation control, cornification, adhesion junctions or lipoxygenase ichthyosis.

name: Cohesin-mediated sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
rationale: All members concern cohesin loading, establishment, maintenance and resolution of sister chromatid cohesion (plus cohesin-driven chromatin looping), distinct from chromosome condensation/CENP-A and spindle neighbours.

core: Ras-family GTPase signaling to MAP kinases
name: Ras-family GTPase activation of MAP2K and p38 signaling
rationale: The three members concern positive Ras-family signaling into MAPK cascades (MAP2K mutants, RIT/RIN to p38), unlike neighbours on RAF/MRAS complexes, RAS GAPs or NTRK3.

name: Telomerase assembly, recruitment and telomere extension
rationale: All members concern telomerase holoenzyme assembly, its localization to telomeres and telomere lengthening, distinct from telomere capping, C-strand synthesis and Cajal-body neighbours.

qualifier: glutamate, GABA and glycine synthesis and transport
name: Glutamate, GABA and glycine neurotransmitter synthesis and transport
rationale: Members concern synthesis, degradation, reuptake and vesicular loading of glutamate, aspartate, GABA, glycine and serine with their transporter disorders; neighbours concern cholinergic or monoamine neurotransmission.

qualifier: APC/C-driven anaphase, chromatid separation and spindle checkpoint
name: APC/C-driven anaphase, sister chromatid separation and mitotic exit
rationale: Members concern APC/C regulation, cohesion resolution and chromatid separation, spindle checkpoint, PLK1/Aurora and cytokinesis; neighbours lack APC/C or emphasize ubiquitin chain types, chromosome condensation or G2/M-E2F control.

qualifier: phosphate and PTH response, bone mineralization
name: FGFR1c-Klotho signaling in phosphate and bone mineralization control
rationale: Members concern FGFR1c/Klotho signaling, responses to phosphate and PTH and promotion of bone mineralization; neighbours concern phosphate transporter defects and ectopic or dental mineralization.

name: Bone mineralization regulation by FGFR1c-Klotho, phosphate and PTH
rationale: Members concern positive and negative regulation of bone mineralization during maturation and its endocrine inputs (FGFR1c-Klotho, phosphate, PTH); neighbours concern vitamin D metabolism or tooth mineralization.

name: Elastic fiber and collagen assembly in aortic wall development
rationale: Members concern elastic fiber assembly and elastin turnover, collagen biosynthesis and crosslinking and aorta development; neighbours concern generic ECM modules, basement membrane or MMP-mediated degradation.

qualifier: leucine and valine, with inborn errors
name: Leucine and valine catabolism and its inborn errors
rationale: All members concern leucine and valine catabolic steps and their enzyme deficiencies; neighbours concern isoleucine/short-chain fatty acids, biotin-dependent carboxylases or 2-hydroxyglutarate.

qualifier: somitogenesis, neural plate and hindbrain segmentation
name: Embryonic axis patterning: somitogenesis, neural plate and hindbrain
rationale: Members concern axis and boundary specification in early embryos (somite segmentation, neural plate/border, rhombomeres, anterior HOX activation); neighbours are Hox gene modules or axial mesoderm and spinal cord patterning.
